predictions.articleTitle: Aarhus Fremad vs Hobro Tactical Breakdown & Match Analysis: Blunt Attack vs Leaky Road Defense

Under 2.5 Goals: Combined lambda_total of 2.35 and big-chance waste rates above 70% for both clubs strongly favor a low-scoring total (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

BTTS: No (1:1 Draw Contingency): Aarhus Fremad's 42.9% clean-sheet rate and 50.0% blank rate edge a one-sided shutout, with Hobro's set-piece threat driving 1:1 risk (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)
